intro: Monaco covers about 2 km² on the French Riviera, making it the most densely populated country in the world.

chapters.title: A tiny coast
text: Monaco is squeezed between the mountains and the Mediterranean and is surrounded by France on land. It has expanded by building new land into the sea, adding about a fifth to its area since the 1960s.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Monaco has a sunny Mediterranean climate with mild winters.

keyTerms.meaning: Creating new land from the sea.
